layers.file: File:Cri loutre d'Asie au zoo de La Bourbansais.webm

species: Smooth-coated otter (Lutrogale perspicillata) calls, a close relative standing in for the sea otter (no free sea otter call recording was found)
note: The high-pass is set to 300 Hz because the zoo recording has low rumble; the otter calls are above 2 kHz.
